[LECC.6.4] **A pattern names a family.** The first segment of an `error
<pattern>:` clause's pattern must be `request`, `internal` or `adapter`
([LECC.2.2]). The compiler must refuse any other with
`DS_VALIDATE_ERROR_PATTERN_UNKNOWN_FAMILY`: no code a conforming adapter or the
engine sends can match it.
